newsitem.title: USA: PSE waives transaction fees on new equity options.
newsitem.headline: PSE waives transaction fees on new equity options.

text.p: The Pacific Stock Exchange (PSE) said it would waive transaction fees on its new flex options that began trading Thursday.
The exchange said fees would be waived for three months from Thursday, in line with the Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) and the American Stock Exchange (AMEX).
The three exchanges Thursday launched flex options on individual stocks. The PSE listed flex options on 10 stocks, the AMEX on 15 and the CBOE on 10.
